question: champs sociaux natifs website.social_* sur Odoo 19 épinglé (odoo:19.0-20260803) : présence, nom exact, édition via Réglages, comportement si vide

sources.content: fields.Char social_facebook, social_instagram, social_twitter, social_linkedin, social_youtube, social_github, social_tiktok, social_discord — all on the website model, with _default_social_* pulling from base.main_company
social_media module defines matching fields on res.company — the upstream source for website defaults
Route /website/social/<string:social> reads website.social_<name>, redirects if truthy, raises NotFound (404) if empty/False

SocialMediaOptionPlugin reads/writes website.social_* via ORM (services.orm.read/write on website model). This is the editing mechanism used when a s_social_media snippet is selected in the website editor.
Company form shows social fields under 'Social Media' group (groups='base.group_no_one' — admin/debug mode only)
Native Odoo footer templates use href='/website/social/facebook' pattern — the controller redirect route, not a direct field read

findings.fieldOrigin: social_media module defines on res.company; website module defines matching fields on website model with defaults pulling from base.main_company
editableVia: Website editor: SocialMediaOptionPlugin reads/writes via ORM when a s_social_media snippet is selected
Company form: Settings > Companies > [Company] > Social Media (groups='base.group_no_one' — admin/debug mode only)
Direct ORM write to website record (programmatic)
findings.emptyBehavior: Controller /website/social/<name> raises werkzeug.exceptions.NotFound (404) if the field is empty/False. No graceful fallback — a link to /website/social/facebook with no URL set gives a 404 page.
findings.nativeHrefPattern: /website/social/facebook — the controller route that redirects to the stored URL
findings.currentValues: All 8 fields default to False (empty) on a fresh instance

verdict: CONFIRMED — social_facebook and social_instagram are native website.Char fields, editableVia the website editor's SocialMediaOptionPlugin (when a s_social_media snippet is selected) or the company form. For our footer: use href='/website/social/facebook' pattern (same as native Odoo footers). Seeding: write default URLs to website.social_facebook and website.social_instagram in the content seed (hooks.py), so the links work out of the box. Empty field = 404 via the redirect controller (named limit D12: icônes fixées, URL vide ne retire pas l'icône).

implicationForImplementation.hrefPattern: Use href='/website/social/facebook' and href='/website/social/instagram' — the native redirect route, consistent with all Odoo footer templates
implicationForImplementation.seeding: Seed default URLs in hooks.py alongside column/copyright content (same idempotence guard). Values: Piqueray's actual Facebook and Instagram profile URLs.
implicationForImplementation.editing: Editing happens via the SocialMediaOptionPlugin when a s_social_media snippet is in scope, OR via the company form. Since our footer does NOT use s_social_media (we inline governed SVGs), the editor won't offer the social links panel automatically. Editing route: company form (Settings > Companies) or programmatic. This is an acceptable limitation per D12 (panneau minimal).
implicationForImplementation.noNewMechanism: No ir.config_parameter needed. The native website.social_* fields are the mechanism.
